results.question: what do I need to finish to get the certificate
results.answer:
Welcome to Hammered University! 

To earn the Product Foundations Certificate, you must complete the following requirements:

* **Required Courses:** Complete PF101, DA110, UX120, and PL201 (12 credits in total) [c-bd79c4e6b1b442d2].
* **Grades:** Each course must be completed with a grade of C or better (a score of 69.9 is a D and does not meet the requirement) [c-bd79c4e6b1b442d2][c-188db0dc304eb0cb]. If you need to retake a failed required course, you may do so under the published retake limit [c-af0a4fdc74470793]. When a course is retaken, both attempts stay on your transcript, but the higher grade is used to assess the certificate requirement [c-188db0dc304eb0cb].
* **Tuition:** All tuition balances must be cleared [c-af0a4fdc74470793]. 

Once all required courses are completed with passing grades, your completion audit finishes, and your tuition balances are cleared, a digital certificate becomes available within an estimated 10 business days after the final grade is posted [c-af0a4fdc74470793].
